```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  setup-copilot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart SDK
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: "stable"

      - name: Setup Flutter SDK
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: "3.19.0"
          channel: "stable"

      - name: Install Dart dependencies
        run: dart pub get

      - name: Configure Dart Workspace
        run: |
          # Create root pubspec.yaml with workspace definition
          cat > pubspec.yaml << EOF
          name: marionette_mcp_workspace
          workspace:
            - packages/*
          resolution: workspace
          EOF

          # Add resolution: workspace to all package pubspecs
          find packages -name "pubspec.yaml" -exec sed -i '1i resolution: workspace' {} \;

      - name: Copy activation job files to agent environment
        uses: githubnext/gh-aw/actions/setup@v0.36.0
        with:
          destination: /home/agent/workspace
```
